# Whaleness — A Third-Party Mobile Client for DeepSeek Harness
**Native Android and iOS apps with core business logic shared through Kotlin Multiplatform.**
Connect to DeepSeek Harness through Mobile Gateway to access workspaces, live conversations, Agent t
races, plugins, scheduled tasks, and files from your phone, tablet, or foldable.
Website: Whaleness
## Overview
Whaleness is an independently developed third-party native mobile client for DeepSeek Harness. Both
Android and iOS apps use Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP):
- `shared` is the source of truth for shared business state, including protocol handling, state mach

ines, reducers, projections, and synchronization.
- `androidApp` implements the Android app with Kot

lin, Jetpack Compose, and OkHttp.
- `DeepSeekHarnessMobile` builds the iOS interface with SwiftUI/UI
Kit and accesses shared logic through a Kotlin/Native framework.
Both apps connect to Harness over WebSocket through `dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway`. With the gateway’s
experimental WebRTC option enabled, paired clients prefer two native RTC data channels and explicitl
y fall back to WebSocket when negotiation fails. Settings shows the selected connection method. See
App integration and validation. Networking, secure storage, files, images, lifecycle handling, and b
ackground execution use native platform APIs. Business rules are consolidated in `shared/commonMain`
wherever practical.
## Downloads and Prerequisites

- **iOS**: Join the TestFlight beta. Supports iPhone and iPad running iOS / iPadOS 16.1 or later.
-
**Android**: Download an APK from GitHub Releases. Requires Android 7.0 (API 24) or later. In-app up

date checks prefer the accelerated download source and verify downloaded packages.
- **Desktop host*
*: Run DeepSeek Harness with **`dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway` 0.11.2 or later** installed and enabled.

`AppRelease/release-info.json` defines the required minimum version.
- **Voice input**: Enable the o
fficial Voice Input plugin in the desktop host's Plugins section, finish model download and initiali
zation, and grant microphone access on the mobile device.
## Beta Community
Join the Whaleness beta WeChat group 2 to share feedback, discuss your experience, and get support.
Scan with WeChat, or save the image and recognize it in WeChat.
> Updated on November 5, 2026. The original image states that the code is valid before November 12,
2026. If it has expired, check the product page for the latest group QR code.
## Platform Status
| Platform / module | Status | Main components |
| KMP `shared` | Used by Android and iOS | Gateway protocol, stores/reducers, conversation and trace
projections, history synchronization, questions/approvals, session control, workspace file state, a

nd code preview support |
| Android | Native client available | Jetpack Compose, OkHttp WebSocket, D
ataStore for non-sensitive settings, Keystore for credentials, CameraX/ML Kit QR scanning, foregroun

d service, attachment cache, file downloads, and previews |
| iOS | Native client available | SwiftU
I/UIKit, URLSession WebSocket, UserDefaults for non-sensitive settings, Keychain for credentials, QR
pairing, background execution, attachments, and workspace files |
> Android and iOS each have their own native UI and platform integrations. Features and interactions
are being aligned, while some system-level behavior differs between platforms.
## Features
### Recent additions
- **Agent teams**: View members, switch between the lead and member conversations, and inspect share

d tasks with status, ownership, and links to the relevant conversation.
- **File uploads**: Choose f
iles in the conversation, follow upload progress, remove attachments, or retry a failed upload. Sent

and generated files appear as cards that can be opened or downloaded.
- **Text selection and tables
**: Open a dedicated text-selection screen to select, select all, and copy without losing your conve
rsation position. Read Markdown tables full screen, rotate them, copy them, or export CSV; narrow ta

bles fit the available width and wide tables scroll horizontally.
- **Chat history and storage**: Ca
che conversations locally and search common conversations offline. Review storage used by images, ch
at history, file previews, and temporary files, and clear local caches by category. Restore history

when returning to a session and load earlier messages progressively.
- **iPhone Duo and wide screens
**: Adapt home-screen columns, safe areas, the composer, and the animated background to folding, unf
olding, and rotation. Wide conversations provide a persistent sidebar with sessions grouped by works

pace; navigation and task controls adapt to the available space.
- **iOS 16.1 compatibility**: The d
eployment target is now iOS 16.1, with compatible interfaces for older systems. System-dependent eff

ects and features remain subject to the iOS version and device capabilities.
- **Refined native inte
ractions**: Improve Android frosted-glass menus, session renaming, and swipe navigation, plus iOS ba
ckground reconnection, file browsing, and image compatibility.
### Conversations and Agent Execution
- **Live native conversations**: Stream WebSocket events with Markdown, code, reasoning, tool calls,

tool results, and image attachments.
- **Voice and text input**: Switch to a dedicated hold-to-talk
area, release to transcribe into an editable draft, or slide up to cancel. Transcription uses the v

oice input capability on the host.
- **History, queues, and commands**: Merge paginated history with
the live tail and deduplicate events. View and edit queued messages, and use slash commands provide

d by the host. On iOS, loading older messages preserves the current reading position.
- **Agent trac
es**: Inspect User, Assistant, and Tool events, including arguments, results, schemas, token usage,

and timing.
